title: Glowing sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Plate / shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='8' fill='#2E4A6B'/>
  <!-- Nori outer wrap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <!-- Nori lit edge -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#5B5B8A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='23' fill='#F5F0E1'/>
  <!-- Rice texture dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#E8E0CC'/>
  <!-- Filling: salmon (orange) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='12' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <!-- Salmon lighter edge -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#FFB07A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Salmon stripes -->
  <path d='M42 44 Q50 40 58 44' stroke='#FFD0A8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 50 Q50 46 58 50' stroke='#FFD0A8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cucumber (green) -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='5' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Avocado (light green) -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#8BC34A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='58' r='2' fill='#C5E1A5'/>
  <!-- Glow effect around the roll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFEB3B'>
    <path d='M22 30 L23.5 33 L26.5 33 L24 35 L25 38 L22 36 L19 38 L20 35 L17.5 33 L20.5 33 Z'/>
    <path d='M78 28 L79 30.5 L81.5 30.5 L79.5 32 L80.5 34.5 L78 33 L75.5 34.5 L76.5 32 L74.5 30.5 L77 30.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M72 72 L72.8 74 L74.8 74 L73.2 75.2 L73.8 77 L72 75.8 L70.2 77 L70.8 75.2 L69.2 74 L71.2 74 Z'/>
    <path d='M28 70 L28.6 71.5 L30.2 71.5 L29 72.5 L29.5 74 L28 73.2 L26.5 74 L27 72.5 L25.8 71.5 L27.4 71.5 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
